body:
Glob2 moves every supported target to native SDL 3.4.16, SDL_image 3.4.6, SDL_ttf 3.2.2 and SDL_net 3.2.0. OpenGL, SDL renderer and software rendering remain available. Native, Android, iOS and browser manifests, build discovery, packaging and release workflows use the pinned dependency family; source downloads are checksum-verified and isolated by target/architecture. The Emscripten toolchain pin remains unchanged.

Three intentional behavior changes:

- UI percentages multiply OS display scale; automatic means multiplier 1. Stored preferences and existing limits remain intact, and `GLOB2_UI_SCALE` remains an absolute override. Display changes update layout, input transforms and font raster density without restarting.
- Native TCP accepts IPv6 addresses and dual-stack connections. Async DNS, cancellation, queued-write backpressure and canonical peer addresses are handled explicitly. WSS/browser transport and IPv4 LAN discovery retain their framing and ports.
- The custom Vorbis/Speex mixer feeds streams bound to default playback, preserving sample-based fades while following output-device changes. Recording backends remain intact.

The shared API port preserves IO ownership, audits boolean success returns, retains millisecond engine timing and owns SDL3 text-event strings through deferred GUI frames. Dialog input converts into logical coordinates once. Rendering, font caches, tests and tools migrate together; packages verify runtime dependency closure and exclude SDL2. Browser dependencies have separate serial/threaded prefixes, and the application launcher owns SDL startup.

The pinned SDK includes narrow X11 reparenting/mapping fixes, applied identically by source builds and vcpkg overlays with patch hashes in cache identity. Source patching uses a private Git repository and canonical LF patch input for Windows/MSYS. Caddy 2.11.4 fixes unsolicited partial responses for complete precompressed browser assets; tests retain exact identity/gzip bytes and real range behavior.

Upstream changes through `0605485aa` are integrated, including browser workers, immutable render scenes, native simulation threading, Castor continuation and sixteen-team support. Both browser runtimes retain serial simulation within their application host. Version gates match upstream: save format 127, save floor 58, replay floor 127 and network protocol 50. The migration introduces no additional bump. The browser playback fixture is regenerated at version 127; historical rejection fixtures remain.

A second agent reviewed the migration and integrations, including shared Windows staging, runtime licenses and new codec coverage. PNG round trips use the production IO loader and retain exact RGBA assertions; the macOS filename loader passes through CoreGraphics. Its feedback is implemented, including deferred text ownership with a real skipped-frame chat regression, coordinate alignment, peer addresses, renderer output dimensions, packaging closure, browser audio/startup lifecycle and isolated display fixtures.

Validation:

- Current native integration passes 413 headless unit cases, 42 focused save/security/replay engine cases, all seven scripting presentation cases, the clean-provenance native scripting corpus, 193 build-system checks and 31 runner checks. The save fixture creates a valid local player required by the hardened loader; every load/presentation/checksum assertion and production guard remains.
- SDL3 serial and threaded simulation each match SDL2 master `0605485aa` in five new-game, generated-map, legacy-save and continuation scenarios: exact per-tick checksums and final saves, with replay bytes matching outside bytes also varying between repeated SDL2 runs. Both scripting fixtures pass frozen traces, exact 1/4-worker replay/save outputs and six continuations. The upstream checker adjusts only the historical save-header contribution.
- Both browser applications and harnesses build. All 48 selected Chromium determinism, scripting-corpus, single-player, storage recovery and threaded startup/audio cases pass. Current native and four browser traces match the original SDL2 baseline byte for byte: 1,500 ticks, seed 42, SHA-256 `4838173acd91d4768a0cd7f3e681cb3ea630de093e27c117994030a8ad31de43`.
- Current IPv4, IPv6 and hostname loopback transport checks pass, including framing, malformed chunks and queue limits. iOS simulator and unsigned device builds pass; all three current simulator startup/background/resume/relaunch checks pass. Prior integration validation also covered 325 headless engine cases, 12 display unit cases, five desktop GUI cases, six editor cases, seven production CLI checks, WSS/LAN, DNS/cancellation, audio PCM equality and iOS lifecycle captures. Prior Mac/Windows package checks and their uploaded traces passed; these support review but do not replace final CI.
- Fresh [Mac packaging](https://github.com/Globulation2/glob2/actions/runs/37054724219), [Windows packaging/smoke](https://github.com/Globulation2/glob2/actions/runs/37054724079) and [full CI, including all three Android ABIs](https://github.com/Globulation2/glob2/actions/runs/37054724288) await runners and gate merge. Reusable Linux jobs preserve bundled SDL3 aliases, runtime-package validation, Openbox and serial display execution. Retained reports, captures, packages, commands and checksum traces provide review evidence.

Coverage limits: real output-device switching, monitor movement and human desktop/mobile playtesting remain unverified. Physical Android/iOS hardware is unavailable. Local Mac fullscreen Space automation and tall-window checks are unavailable; CI retains exact-size/fullscreen assertions. Two Android shell scene tests require a Java Activity. Docker is unavailable locally; deployment checks remain in CI. The user approved merging with these documented hardware/playtest limits; automated checks still gate merge. One retained English font sample widened from 151 to 154 pixels under SDL_ttf3; Arabic/mixed-script captures and mixer PCM matched.

Reproducible commands, fixtures, captures and performance evidence remain under ignored `artifacts/sdl3/`; temporary notes stay in `docs/.work/`. No store builds are published and no YOG services are deployed. Rollback uses the previous packaged release or reverts the migration merge. Any unexplained migration-induced simulation difference blocks cutover.
title: Migrate supported builds to SDL3 with OS scaling, IPv6 and default-device audio
